description: Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha - List of the Roads and Throughfares of Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically deals with the confirmation and listing of roads and thoroughfares owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Kalpitiya local government authority. The content focuses on land/property matters (road ownership and classification) rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. It includes detailed schedules of specific roads with coordinates and measurements, which falls under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
